name: Pulse
author: AlteringUX
description: A cross-plugin activity feed and 'this plugin needs action' signal: a bar bell with an unread count, a panel that lists what the alteringux.* plugins have been doing and picks the one thing to do next. Log + attention state owned by ~/.local/bin/omarchy-pulse.

barWidget.description: Bell with an unread badge that reddens when a plugin needs action; click for the activity feed and the next-action pick.
